steps.en: Install the Mac app; your Ghostty config carries over
steps.zh: 装上 Mac 应用，Ghostty 配置直接沿用
steps.code: brew tap manaflow-ai/cmux · brew install --cask cmux

steps.en: Wire your agent CLIs into cmux once
steps.zh: 一次性把 agent 命令行接进 cmux

steps.en: Writes hook entries into each agent's config so its hooks call cmux notify
steps.zh: 往各 agent 配置写 hook，让它们调用 cmux notify

steps.en: Open a workspace per task, split panes, launch agents as usual
steps.zh: 每个任务开一个工作区，分屏，照常启动 agent

steps.en: Sidebar tab shows branch, PR, cwd, ports and the latest agent message
steps.zh: 侧边标签显示分支、PR、目录、端口和 agent 最新消息

steps.en: When an agent waits for you, rings its pane and badges its tab
steps.zh: agent 等你时，给它的窗格套光圈、标签加角标

steps.en: Jump straight to the agent that needs you
steps.zh: 直接跳到需要你的那个 agent

value.en: No more cycling through tabs to find which agent is stuck on "Claude is waiting for your input" — the one that needs you is lit
value.zh: 不用再挨个翻标签找哪个 agent 卡在“等待输入”——需要你的那个自己亮起来

sources: README 'Install > Homebrew' (brew tap manaflow-ai/cmux; brew install --cask cmux) and 'Ghostty compatible' bullet (reads ~/.config/ghostty/config)
README 'Session restore' and docs/agent-hooks.md (cmux hooks setup; installed files per agent such as ~/.codex/hooks.json; Claude Code via the cmux wrapper)
README 'Keyboard Shortcuts' tables (⌘ N new workspace, ⌘ D split right, ⌘ ⇧ U jump to latest unread)
README 'Why cmux?' (sidebar shows git branch, linked PR status/number, working directory, listening ports, latest notification text; blue ring and tab lights up when an agent is waiting)
